summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty. Core shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights, also a validateApp caller, would otherwise break) pass owner from package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts is an in-repo lib inlined at build, so no version bump/registry release or dependency update was needed; one PR covers all three sub-tasks (must land together). Owner values hardcoded to match package.json. PR #1 merged, CI+CD green.
